status: engineering source review; not native extraction, scientific atlas admission, or exhaustive ontology validation

methods.material_at_distinguishing_boundary: Cap-selected RNA-cDNA hybrids, followed by recovered 5-prime-complete cDNA

After RNA removal, cDNA no longer physically carries an RNA cap; cap selection is provenance, not a DNA terminal modification.

design_conclusion.diagnosis: The difficulty is not that components is too short a name. RNA/DNA/protein alone encodes chemistry class while losing selected biological population, preparation and representational origin. More free-text slots will not fix this.
design_conclusion.scientist_facing_state: Display the actual preparation, such as cap-selected 5-prime-complete cDNA, peptide-crosslinked RNA fragment, or RT-truncated cDNA. Back the phrase with addressable facts rather than an independent unsupported label.
minimal_change: Retain molecule class as a coarse filter, not the principal description.
Represent relevant material entities with their type and specific identity; link covalent/hybridization relations to exact partners.
Derive selection history and molecular origin through producing Operations, with a queryable summary; do not pretend a selected property remains chemically present after transfer to cDNA.
Record consequential end chemistry, topology, modifications and copied/attached sequence segments when they determine the operation or comparison.
State the observed signal and biological interpretation at method/readout level; sequence identity, truncation, substitutions and abundance are different readouts.
conditional_rules: For affinity capture, identify what is captured, recognition partner/handle and whether handle is direct or on an associated molecule.
For RT, identify RNA population and whether the assay uses full-length, truncated or mutation-bearing cDNA.
For end-based assays, identify which original molecular end is represented and what makes that population selectable.
negative_controls: CAGE and PARE are not equivalent just because both recover RNA 5-prime information.
iCLIP linear cDNA before and after circularization/linearization can share DNA/topology labels but differ in amplifiability and recovered population.
PAR-CLIP and temporal 4SU assays must not acquire a shared biological purpose simply from a common label.
irCLIP post-RT streptavidin capture is not an immune capture because both appear as purification on beads.
design_conclusion.evolution_use: A comparison should state retained substrate/workflow, changed operation or retained population, new observable, benefit and limitations. Shared RNA/DNA label supplies a retrieval filter only, never a scientific edge.
